summary: Supporters follow up with a coworker again and again about whether they signed a card.
realLife: Attorneys quoted in an HR article said workers sometimes sign cards just to stop repeated follow-up, and card signing can happen covertly.
sources: SHRM, NLRB general counsel calls union organizing card check: https://www.shrm.org/topics-tools/employment-law-compliance/nlrb-general-counsel-calls-union-organizing-card-check
inGame: a coworker tie with repeated asks; needs: unions as organizations and card records

turns.summary: The coworker signs and resents it.
The coworker says they are not ready and the asker backs off.
The coworker mentions the pressure to a supervisor.
